oPlano.pt: O plano, a normal e a distância de P
oPlano.fr: Le plan, la normale et la distance de P
oPlano.en: The plane, the normal and P’s distance

descricaoVista.pt: Desenho em perspectiva de um pedaço do plano, do vetor normal e do segmento perpendicular de P até o plano, que mede {d}.
descricaoVista.fr: Dessin en perspective d’un morceau du plan, du vecteur normal et du segment perpendiculaire de P au plan, qui mesure {d}.
descricaoVista.en: Perspective drawing of a patch of the plane, the normal vector and the perpendicular segment from P to the plane, which measures {d}.

leitura.pt: Os coeficientes a, b, c são a normal: mude-os e veja o plano girar. O tracejado é o caminho mais curto de P ao plano, paralelo à normal; mova P para dentro do plano e a distância vai a zero.
leitura.fr: Les coefficients a, b, c sont la normale : changez-les et voyez le plan tourner. Les pointillés sont le chemin le plus court de P au plan, parallèle à la normale ; placez P dans le plan et la distance devient nulle.
leitura.en: The coefficients a, b, c are the normal: change them and watch the plane turn. The dashed line is the shortest path from P to the plane, parallel to the normal; move P onto the plane and the distance drops to zero.
